references.title: VI-RADS followed by photodynamic transurethral resection of non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer vs white-light conventional and second-resection: the 'CUT-less' randomised trial protocol

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Estimated enrollment

  • 327 participants

Study setting

  • primary or recurrent
  • only intermediate/high risk

Eligibility criteria

  • female and male patients aged ≥ 18 years referred for clinical suspicion of primary or recurrent BC who have been advised to undergo TURBT
  • patients with a TUR-confirmed diagnosis of NMIBC and candidate for second-look and resection (Re-TURBT) according to EAU Guidelines
  • no imaging evidence (i.e., mpMRI/VI-RADS Score 1 or 2) of muscle-invasive, locally advanced, or metastatic BC (i.e., only confirmed CIS, Ta, T1, N0, M0 will be considered eligible)
  • patients who did or did not previously receive adjuvant intravesical BCG immunotherapy (i.e., BCG non-naıve or na€ıve patients) for previous BC history
  • fit to undergo all procedures listed in protocol
  • able to provide written informed consent

Non-eligibility criteria

  • contraindication to TURBT and/or Re-TURBT
  • initial TURBT diagnosis of MIBC (i.e., T2) or locally advanced BC (i.e., T3-T4)
  • preoperative evidence of metastatic disease (i.e., cN1-N3 and/or cM1)
  • visual evidence of low-risk NMIBC (solitary tumour and/or < 1 cm) before initial TURBT
  • visual evidence of MIBC on preliminary cystoscopy (i.e., non-papillary or sessile mass attached directly by its base without a stalk) or on pre-TURBT mpMRI/VI-RADS (Score 3-5)
  • TURBT diagnosis of NMIBCs not eligible for Re-TURBT according to EAU Guidelines (i.e., Ta-LG; Ta-HG with detrusor muscle in the specimen; primary CIS)
  • concomitant upper tract (kidney or ureteric) tumours on imaging contraindication to adjuvant intravesical BCG immunotherapy
  • pregnancy and breast-feeding women
  • unfit to undergo any procedures listed in protocol

characteristics.name: Outcomes
characteristics.value:
Primary outcomes

  • early bladder cancer recurrence within 3 months 

Secondary outcomes

  • the relative proportions of patients with late bladder cancer recurrences, defined as first recurrence after 4.5 months (including progression to MIBC, distant metastases, and death from bladder cancer) in patients without an early recurrence detected at the time of assessment of the primary outcome
  • the relative proportions of patients with progression to MIBC, defined as the time from randomisation to first increase to bladder cancer stage ≥ T2 or distant metastases
  • time to late bladder cancer recurrences, defined as for secondary outcome
  • time to progression to MIBC, defined as for secondary outcome

characteristics.value: The Impact of PDD During TURB for NMIBC (TUR_BLUE)

characteristics.name: Participants
characteristics.value:
Estimated enrollment

  • not reported

Study setting

  • primary

Eligibility criteria

  •  voluntarily signed informed consent per Good Clinical Practice and national regulations
  • age ≥ 18 years
  • patient planned for TURBT for > 1.5 cm suspected (with either abdomen ultrasound or flexible cystoscopy) primary bladder cancer. The cut-off of 1.5 cm has been chosen to maximize the probability of enrolling high-risk patients and, consequently, to maximize the probability of performing the re-TURBT

Non-eligibility criteria

  • patients with history of recurrent NMIBC
  • patients with visible incomplete resection during primary TURBT
  • patients with metastatic disease or with a preoperative computertomography scan highly suspected for MIBC
